meta_description:
4,756 likes, 30 comments - mahathalli on October 5, 2026: "You know when someone gets way too defensive about their favourite thing? 😂

I casually pointed out a few things about our Bosch Dishwasher… and let’s just say, he had a LOT to say. 😌

But after looking at what it actually does, I kind of get it:

✨ Up to 80 everyday Indian utensils — and smaller bowls and spoons can take the count up to 100.
✨ Intensive Kadhai Programme — made for tough Indian cooking stains, so no pre-scrubbing needed.
✨ Steam Treatment + 70°C Hot Water Wash — helps tackle stubborn oil and grease while being suitable for delicate crockery.
✨ 2 Powerful Spray Arms — designed for effective pressure and coverage, so water reaches every corner.
✨ 10-Year Anti-Rust Warranty — for long-term protection of the dishwasher interior.
✨ 100% Money-Back Guarantee — if you’re not satisfied with the cleaning, Bosch has you covered.

Add a Finish tablet, switch on the Intensive Kadhai Programme and let Bosch handle the rest😌

Okay fine… maybe I did take the rage bait a little too far. 😂

#BoschDishwasher #BoschHomeAppliances #FinishTablet #FinishDishwasherTablets #AD".
